basics.summary: Experienced software engineer with a track record of creating intelligent and robust software systems. As a special projects developer at Wolfram, I have successfully developed a variety of internal tools and software for finance, outreach, HR, and other departments. During my MSc thesis project, I made an appearance on Shark Tank Mexico. I have a deep technical expertise in design of software systems, Python and Wolfram Language, and I am committed to applying those skills to deliver business value.

My expertise with the Wolfram technology stack allows for seamless integration with other systems, including relational databases, other programing languages, ERPs, external websites and RESTful APIs.
